//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Set World Spawn Point -> Config

Enable Set World Spawn Point.//: Whether Set World Spawn Point is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

_forceExactSpawn.//: If enabled, spawns players on the exact world spawn instead of around it.

xCoordSpawnPoint.//: The X coordinate of the spawn point of newly created worlds. min: -100,000, max: 100,000

yCoordSpawnPoint.//: The Y coordinate of the spawn point of newly created worlds. By default -1, which means it'll be the first solid block descending from the top of the world. min: -1, max: 2,000

zCoordSpawnPoint.//: The Z coordinate of the spawn point of newly created worlds. min: -100,000, max: 100,000
